author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Anbernic RG55G1 sits in a strange position: it has a good design and no major faults, but it also doesn't do anything exceptionally well -- even compared to handhelds within their own catalog.

More info:
Anbernic direct: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-RG55G1
AliExpress: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c3uhYt2P

Impressions video: https://youtu.be/Kxv-l-QWdcI
Anbernic RG476H review: https://youtu.be/cCx4BpIrTRY

CRT shaders that work well on the device: https://www.reddit.com/r/SBCGaming/comments/1k9gwcd/crt_shaders_that_work_on_the_retroid_pocket/

Turnip GPU drivers:
A12 GameNative: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/work_items/14596#note_3421695
Gamma's drivers: https://github.com/TheGammaSqueeze/sd-tools/tree/main/gpu/turnip-dist

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.

Check out my weekly newsletter: http://news.retrogamecorps.com/
